title: Run registration
description: The body of the signed POST to the server's run endpoint, run.url, application/json, with which the gateway registers a run before it starts: the run's id, its labels and what it is about, and what the gateway announces for the run. The answer is a signed 200 whose body is the run's run configuration, run-configuration.schema.json; {"version": 1} is an answer of no policy. The gateway builds the body once and sends the same bytes on every try, time included, which a server that accepted them under the same access key answers the same again, and the same run id under another access key, even with the same bytes, or other bytes, is a signed 409 run_id_used; the signature covers the body, and a server refuses a time outside 300 seconds of its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request, and so is a label value over 256 bytes of UTF-8, which the schema cannot state.

version.description: The document format. A server refuses a version it does not read.

run_id.description: The run's id: a UUID in the canonical lower-case form, the subject of every event of the run.

labels.description: The run's labels, as dev.qory.run.started contains them: at most 16, each value at most 256 bytes of UTF-8. Each maxLength counts characters and is an upper bound of the byte limit: a body with a value over 256 bytes is a signed 400 invalid_request, though this schema passes it. The server decides which labels identify what the run works on, and chooses the run configuration for them. Absent means none.

about.description: What the run is about, as dev.qory.run.started contains it. It is for display: it never selects or changes a security policy. Absent means none.

forager_version.description: The Forager module version, as Go stamps it.

contract_version.description: The revision of this contract Forager implements, the same integer as the X-Qory-Contract-Version header.

interval_seconds.description: The heartbeat interval the run uses, in seconds: heartbeats run from the accepted registration until the run's final event, so the server's liveness window follows the run's own value. A larger value fails the schema, a signed 400 invalid_request.

events.description: The event types the server receives, as its configuration lists them.

time.description: When the gateway built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds, such as 2026-10-10T12:00:00Z. A server refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401, as it refuses a GET's timestamp.
